Subject: MAP draft: target close & procurement signature deadline

Hi Sara / Tom —

Great to meet you both on the call today. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures the milestones we discussed and the responsibilities for each party. Key points:

- Proposed target close date: 2026-09-23 (dependent on procurement signature)
- Proposed procurement/contract signature deadline: 2026-09-15 (we noted procurement may need extra review time)
- Milestones (rough):
  1) Executive review (FintechCo) — by 2026-08-31
  2) Technical validation / trial run (FintechCo & Redwood) — 2026-09-07
  3) Procurement & legal review (FintechCo) — 2026-09-10 to 2026-09-15
  4) Contract signature & onboarding kickoff — 2026-09-16 to 2026-09-23

Responsibilities (high level):
- FintechCo: executive approval, procurement sign-off, technical test resources
- Redwood: contract & term sheet, trial environment, SOC2 evidence links, MAP updates

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached MAP (FintechCo_MAP_v1.xlsx) and mark any changes to milestones or owners.
2) Confirm procurement's target signature date (important for our pricing hold window).
3) If you want, we can schedule a short 30-min sync this week to finalize dates.

Attachment: FintechCo_MAP_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 24 KB)

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.
